small.description: One focused unit-test file or modest lint/format check with bounded workers

medium.description: Typecheck, a bounded unit-test selection, or a modest build

browser-e2e.description: Complete headless browser/Electron test stack, including bundler, daemon and test agents; one test worker

heavy.description: Large build, coverage run, or unfamiliar expensive command; conservative fallback

native.description: Native/Gradle build, build plus emulator, or large VM journey; requires a host budget that fits
